name: text-roll
title: 文本翻滚 Text Roll
description: 悬停或挂载时逐字符翻滚的文字效果。

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of each character roll in seconds.

props.name: getEnterDelay
props.description: Delay for each character entering the roll.

props.name: getExitDelay
props.description: Delay for each character returning to rest.

props.name: transition
props.description: Motion transition merged into every character.

props.name: variants
props.description: Rest and hover states for each character track.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Play on hover or immediately on mount.

usage: `TextRoll` 复制每个字符并纵向滚动第二份内容，适合导航链接、简短按钮和展示标题。默认悬停触发，不会持续争夺注意力。
extended: 使用 `trigger="mount"` 可在挂载时播放，`getEnterDelay` 和 `getExitDelay` 用来改变字符波次。自定义 `variants` 时保留 `rest` 与 `hover` 两个状态名。
events: 组件使用鼠标进入和离开控制默认效果，其余 `<span>` 事件继续透传。减少动态效果时保留静态文字。
